Homeownership is part of the California Dream and [image: Homeownership is part of the California Dream and it was an honor to return as keynote speaker for My Way Home’s 5th Annual Leading People Home Awards Ceremony and 25th Anniversary Celebration. Led by Executive Director Bertha Garcia and her small but mighty team, My Way Home has helped make that dream possible for thousands of families: 🏡 3,828+ families supported with buying or preserving a home, or becoming mortgage-ready 📚 25,753+ people reached through education and coaching 💰 $18.7 million+ in down payment and closing-cost assistance awarded 🏦 $237 million+ in first and second mortgage financing One story that stayed with me was Veronica’s. A single mom of three, she never thought homeownership was within reach. With My Way Home’s support, she qualified for California’s Dream for All program after a year on the waitlist. Her family received the keys last Thanksgiving and now has the stability and peace of mind of a home of their own, with room for their dog to run and play. Congratulations to this year’s remarkable awardees: • Lynn L. Jacobs Excellence in Lifetime Leadership Award: Celina Zacharias, Port of Hueneme Harbor Commissioner. Lynn, we miss you. ❤️ • Rodney Fernandez Founders Award for Excellence in Visionary Leadership: Jessica Wishan de L’Arbre, CEO of Habitat for Humanity of Southern Santa Barbara County • Michael Maguire Excellence in Community Partnership Award: Ventura County Credit Union • Ernest Baskette Jr. Excellence in Community Support Award: Yvonne Gutierrez, Executive Director of El Concilio Family Services • Carmen Ramirez Excellence in Advocacy and Community Impact Award: Mexican Consulate in Oxnard, represented by the Hon. Ricardo Santana Velázquez Here’s to 25 years of helping people find a place to call home and to many more families building a brighter future. #MyWayHome #Homeownership #CaliforniaDream #DreamForAll #AffordableHousing #CommunityImpact #HousingStability #VenturaCounty #LeadingPeopleHome]

Reliable medical transportation is part of healthc [image: Reliable medical transportation is part of healthcare. For people who can’t drive, including patients who need regular dialysis, a dependable ride can mean the difference between making an appointment and missing care. Call the Car helps connect Californians with medical appointments. Its current case study reports nearly 500,000 trips per month and a 99.5% ride fulfillment rate. But transportation providers face rising fuel, insurance, and labor costs while reimbursement can lag behind the cost of delivering reliable service. We need fair, up-to-date reimbursement so patients can keep getting to the care they need. Every ride matters. Every patient deserves to arrive with dignity. Doug Powell’s original recycled keyboard-key mosaics are remarkable. #CallTheCar #MedicalTransportation #HealthcareAccess #Dialysis #PatientCare #MediCal #California @ctc_n_you]
